narrative:
Wayne County has 68,896 registered voters, with 16.1% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 33.5% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 45.2%, a clear Democratic lean of 11.7 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 30.4% of registrants.
